section_summary: This section contains copies of industrial licence agreements involving Japanese manufacturers and foreign patent holders. The agreements cover carburettors, railway signals, chemical processes, titanium pigments, aircraft equipment and powered door controls. Several documents record later assignments or amendments to earlier licences.

subfiles.title: Solex–Kokusan Kogyo carburettor licence agreement
subfiles.about: Exclusive manufacture and sale of Solex carburettors in specified Japanese territories.
subfiles.summary: The surviving clauses set brand rights, sales royalties, annual minimum payments, technical assistance, patent duties, accounting and remittances. They restrict manufacture and sales territory, govern infringement and transfer, and set a term through 1951.

subfiles.title: Assignment of Solex licence to Hitachi
subfiles.from: Kokusan Kogyo Kabushiki Kaisha; Société Anonyme Solex
subfiles.about: Transfer of Kokusan Kogyo’s Solex carburettor licence to Hitachi.
subfiles.summary: Following their planned amalgamation, Hitachi assumes the licence obligations with Solex’s consent.

subfiles.title: Amendment to Solex–Hitachi carburettor agreement
subfiles.about: Postponement of minimum royalties and extension of the Solex licence.
subfiles.summary: Machinery procurement delays defer annual minimum royalties by one year. The parties credit an earlier payment and extend the agreement through December 1952.

subfiles.title: Kyosan Engineering Works contract cover
subfiles.about: Cover identifying a Kyosan Engineering Works contract.
subfiles.summary: Identifies Kyosan Engineering Works and its Yokohama address; bears an October 1946 date stamp.

subfiles.title: Union Switch & Signal–Kyosan railway signalling agreement
subfiles.about: Japanese territorial manufacture and sale of railway signalling apparatus under American patents and technical assistance.
subfiles.summary: The agreement grants a territorial patent licence and access to designs and manufacturing information. It sets a capital stock arrangement, supply and sales conditions, patent enforcement, confidentiality, term and arbitration. Signatures and acknowledgments follow.

subfiles.title: Modification of Union Switch & Signal–Kyosan agreement
subfiles.about: Patent application exchanges and changes to Kyosan’s capital stock obligations.
subfiles.summary: The companies agree on monthly patent application copies, Japanese and Manchurian filings and maintenance expenses. Union gives up its share of capital increases devoted solely to other product lines.

subfiles.title: Swedish log patent rights contract
subfiles.from: Svenska Aktiebolaget Log; Yamatake Kogyo K.K.
subfiles.about: Limited use of Swedish log patent rights for Japanese Navy orders.
subfiles.summary: The contract permits specified patent use for naval manufacture, sets a fee and remedies, and provides cancellation conditions.

subfiles.title: Hooker Electrochemical–Kanto Sanso process agreement
subfiles.about: Use in Japan of Hooker electrolytic processes for alkalis, chlorine and bleach.
subfiles.summary: Hooker promises instruction, equipment models, assistance and an exclusive Japanese patent licence. Kanto Sanso undertakes to build a plant, share technical improvements and pay a portion of defined net profits. The agreement also covers accounts, secrecy, termination and arbitration; signatures and acknowledgments follow.

subfiles.title: Kokusan Kogyo–Titan Kogyo titanium pigment licence
subfiles.about: Exclusive licensing of patents and processes for titanium pigments.
subfiles.summary: The agreement defines the licensed field, patent filing and cost duties, sublicensing, infringement actions and the effect of Kokusan’s share ownership. The copy ends during a clause on obligations to cooperating companies.

subfiles.title: Handley Page–Mitsubishi slotted wing licence
subfiles.about: Exclusive use of Handley Page slotted wing patents for Japanese naval aircraft.
subfiles.summary: The licence records payments and bonds arising from a 1928 agreement and restricts manufacture to Japanese naval use. It provides drawings, engineering help, reciprocal improvement disclosures, patent marking, confidentiality and arbitration. A patent schedule and execution page close the copy.

subfiles.title: Farman–Mitsubishi aircraft compressor licence
subfiles.from: Société Henry, Maurice et Dick Farman
subfiles.about: Manufacture of patented aircraft compressor equipment in Japan and Manchuria.
subfiles.summary: The licence allows local manufacture and export with Japanese-built engines, provides drawings and technical assistance, and sets purchase payments and royalties.

subfiles.title: Identification sheet for National Pneumatic agreement
subfiles.about: Authentication of an attached agreement copy.
subfiles.summary: Frank Johnson identifies the attached copy under a National Pneumatic board resolution.

subfiles.title: National Pneumatic board resolution
subfiles.about: Authorization for L. J. Musser to execute a Mitsubishi manufacturing agreement.
subfiles.summary: The board authorizes Musser to contract with Mitsubishi; Frank Johnson certifies the resolution.

subfiles.title: Consular acknowledgment of National Pneumatic–Mitsubishi agreement
subfiles.from: J. W. Ballantine, United States consul
subfiles.about: Acknowledgment of the attorneys’ execution of the agreement.
subfiles.summary: The consul certifies the appearances and acknowledgments of L. J. Musser and Hideo Takeda.

subfiles.title: National Pneumatic–Mitsubishi powered door control agreement
subfiles.about: Manufacture and sale of powered door control apparatus in Japan and its dependencies.
subfiles.summary: National Pneumatic grants technical assistance and an exclusive territorial patent licence. Mitsubishi agrees to restricted sales, confidentiality, a ten percent sales payment, accounting and patent notices. The agreement also specifies its term, notices and arbitration; its text continues into the top of page 215.

subfiles.title: 1936 amendment to National Pneumatic–Mitsubishi agreement
subfiles.about: Amendment and continuation of the 1925 powered door control agreement.
subfiles.summary: The amendment ratifies the earlier agreement with changes and sets a revised term and termination notice.
